podcast.body: This single from The Shins' self-titled album showcases Danger Mouse's drumming, which intentionally drags slightly behind the beat. This "imperfection" is highlighted as providing crucial emotional vibe and excitement, contrasting with overly precise, quantized modern production. "Listen to this single called The High Road. Dangermas is playing drums here, and listen to how he drags ever so slightly behind the beat."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
